title: Na dialect
description: Sino-Tibetan language of Arunachal Pradesh, India
extract: Na (Nah) is a dialect of Bangni, a Sino-Tibetan language spoken in India. Na is spoken in nine villages of Taksing Circle, Upper Subansiri District, Arunachal Pradesh. There are four clans, namely Chedar, Hafi, Tisi, and Hari.
